app.languageLoadError: The stored language could not be read. The default language German is shown.
app.languageSaveError: The language could not be saved. The last confirmed language stays active.
app.languageSaveUnconfirmedError: The language could not be saved. The default language German is shown because the stored language could not be read.

tip.data: Which historical price data is available; import files and choose the broker for test runs.
tip.accounts: Create, edit, save and delete test accounts.

errors.host: The backend refused the request because the name of the address is not allowed. Next step: open pipwerk replay at 127.0.0.1 or localhost, or enter the name in the startup configuration.
errors.origin: The backend refused the request because it comes from a web page with another address. Next step: open pipwerk replay at its own address and try again.
errors.notFound: What you are looking for does not exist (any more). Next step: reload the view.
errors.conflict: The backend cannot carry out the request now because it collides with something that is running. Next step: try again in a moment.
errors.importRunning: An import process exists. While it exists, nothing can be deleted. Next step: wait until the import has ended, or cancel it in the dialog "Import files", and try again. An import process to which no file comes for some time ends by itself.
errors.tooLarge: The backend refused the request because of its size. Next step: reload the page and try again.
errors.mediaType: The backend does not accept this kind of request. Next step: reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid: The backend considers the input invalid. Next step: check the input.
errors.busy: The backend is busy right now. Next step: try again in a moment.
errors.dataStock: The data stock could not be read or changed. Next step: try again; if the error stays, check the messages of the backend.
errors.server: The backend reports an error. Next step: try again; if the error stays, check the messages of the backend.
errors.network: The backend is unreachable. Next step: check that pipwerk replay is running and try again.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Next step: reload the page and try again.

accounts.title: Test accounts
accounts.intro: A test account is a named, stored set of values for the settlement of a test run: initial capital, currency, leverage, spread and commission. It is not tied to an instrument.
accounts.empty: There is no test account. Next step: create a new one.
accounts.formEmpty: Next step: choose a test account on the left or create a new one.
accounts.loadError: The test accounts could not be read.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.deleteText: The test account "{{name}}" is deleted. Saved backtests keep their copy of the values.
accounts.deleteDefaultHint: pipwerk replay creates the built-in default test account again with its original values at the next start.
accounts.saveError: The test account could not be saved. {{reason}}
accounts.deleteError: The test account could not be deleted. {{reason}}

tip.name: The name under which you choose the test account in a test run.
tip.capital: The money a test run starts with.
tip.currency: The currency in which profit, loss and costs are shown. Three capital letters, for example EUR.
tip.leverage: How much more market value you can move with the money; 30 means 1:30.
tip.commission: Fee per traded lot, once for opening and once for closing, in account currency.
tip.spread: The spread is the distance between buy and sell price. "From the candles" takes the spread the broker delivers per candle; "fixed" uses a fixed value in points (a point is the smallest price step of the instrument).

problem.name: The name must be given (at most 100 characters, without control characters).
problem.capital: The initial capital must be greater than 0.
problem.currency: The account currency consists of exactly three capital letters, for example EUR.
problem.leverage: The leverage must be a whole number from 1 to 1000.
problem.spread: The fixed spread must be a number from 0 to 100000 points.
problem.commission: The commission must be a number from 0 to 100000.

data.title: Data stock
data.intro: The historical price data the test runs read from.
data.testBrokerApplies: No broker is chosen. A test run reads the data of {{broker}}, the first broker in alphabetical order.
data.deleteBroker: Delete all data of this broker …
data.deleteBrokerSeveral: The filter fits several brokers. Next step: enter the name of a single broker if you want to delete all its data.
data.testBrokerError: The broker for test runs could not be read or saved. {{reason}}
data.loadError: The data stock could not be read. {{reason}}
data.empty: The data stock is empty. Next step: get price data with pipwerk-fetch-mt5 on the computer of MetaTrader 5 and import the files with "Import files …".
data.noMatch: No series matches the filter. Next step: change a filter or clear it.
data.rowTip: Click to show the details of this series.
data.detailsError: The details could not be read. {{reason}}
data.gapsExplain: A gap is a period between two imported periods of this series in which the broker traded. Weekends, holidays and other times without trade are no gaps.
data.contractMissing: There is no contract data for this instrument at this broker. A test run with this instrument does not start then. Next step: get the contract data with pipwerk-fetch-mt5 and import the file.

tip.import: Opens the dialog in which you choose files in JSON or CSV format and import them.
tip.testBroker: The broker whose price data a test run reads. You can choose among the brokers that occur in the data stock. If none is chosen, the first one in alphabetical order applies.
tip.filterBroker: Shows only series of brokers whose name contains this text. Upper and lower case do not matter.
tip.filterInstrument: Shows only series of instruments whose name contains this text, for example EUR.
tip.filterData: Shows only series of this kind: for example h1 for candles H1, ticks for ticks or contract for contract data. The text must occur in the identifier of the data, so h1 also shows h12.
tip.columnBroker: The broker the data comes from, for MetaTrader 5 the name of the trade server.
tip.columnInstrument: The instrument the data belongs to.
tip.columnData: What the series contains: candles of a time unit, ticks or contract data.
tip.columnPeriod: From the first to the last day for which there is data (UTC).
tip.columnGaps: How many gaps the series has: periods between imported periods in which the broker traded and that have no data. Weekends, holidays and other times without trade do not count.
tip.deleteOpen: Deletes this series completely or a period of it. Before that you see what would be deleted and confirm it.
tip.deleteContract: Deletes the contract data of this instrument at this broker. Before that you see what would be deleted and confirm it.
tip.deleteBroker: Deletes all series and all contract data of the broker the table is filtered by. Before that you see what would be deleted and confirm it.
tip.tickSize: Smallest price change of the instrument.
tip.tickValue: Value of a price change by one tick for one lot, in the given currency.
tip.pip: One pip as price difference. Buffers and distances of strategies are often given in pips.
tip.spread: Usual distance between ask and bid.
tip.volumeStep: Smallest step in which the volume can change.
tip.contractSize: How many units one lot contains, for example 100,000 euros for EURUSD.
tip.swap: Fee or income for a position held overnight, for long and short.
tip.tripleSwap: The weekday on which the swap is charged for three days.
tip.margin: Collateral tied up for one lot, in account currency. A dash means the broker gave no value.
tip.contractFrom: The moment the broker delivered these values.

import.title: Import files
import.intro: Choose as many files in JSON or CSV format as you like, for example exports of MetaTrader 5 or the files of pipwerk-fetch-mt5, and click "Import" once. pipwerk replay checks the files one after the other and takes over the data. Existing data of the same moment is replaced.
import.empty: No file chosen yet. Next step: choose files in JSON or CSV format.
import.reading: The files are being read … ({{done}} of {{total}})
import.readError: The files could not be read. {{reason}}
import.timezone: Time zone of the CSV files
import.missing: Instrument or data not recognised. Complete the entry or remove the file.
import.unreadable: {{reason}} The file will be refused by the import.
import.jsonData: The content of the file determines the data.
import.nextFiles: Next step: complete instrument and data of the marked files or remove the files.
import.nextTimezone: Next step: enter the time zone of the CSV files, for example Europe/Athens.
import.nextAgain: Next step: complete the refused files and click "Import" again; the files that were not imported are then caught up, too. Or close the dialog.
import.cancelNote: The import ends after the file that is being taken over. The other files stay "not imported".
import.closeAsk: The import is still running. Cancel it? Files that are already taken over stay taken over.
import.skipped: This file was not imported. Next step: click "Import" again to catch it up.
import.processEnded: The backend ended the import process because no file came for too long. Next step: click "Import" again. Files that are already taken over stay taken over.
import.resultTaken: {{accepted}} rows taken over, {{replaced}} of them as replacement. Period: {{period}} (UTC).

tip.choose: Chooses one or more files from your hard disk, JSON and CSV mixed. The files are checked and never executed.
tip.broker: The broker all files belong to, for MetaTrader 5 the name of the trade server. Choose a name from the data stock or enter a new one. If all JSON files name the same broker, it is preset. The broker also counts for JSON files.
tip.timezone: The time zone in which MetaTrader 5 writes the times of the CSV files (time of the trade server), as a name, for example Europe/Athens. Daylight saving time is taken into account. pipwerk converts all times to UTC. Times in JSON files are UTC.
tip.instrument: The instrument of the file, for example EURUSD. Preset from the file name, for JSON from the content.
tip.data: What the file contains: candles of a time unit or ticks. Preset from the file name; for JSON the content determines the data.
tip.cancel: Ends the import after the file that is being taken over. What is already taken over stays taken over; the other files are not imported.

reject.columns_mismatch: The row has too few columns.
reject.field_unknown: The entry contains an unknown field.
reject.value_invalid: A value is not a valid number.
reject.time_out_of_range: The moment is outside the supported range (1970 to 2100).
reject.local_time_not_existing: This local time does not exist (change to daylight saving time).
reject.time_not_ascending: The moment is not after the moment of the row before.
reject.time_duplicate: The moment occurs several times in the file.
reject.price_not_positive: A price is not greater than 0.

fileError.too_large: The file is larger than the limit of {{limit}} per file. Next step: split it into smaller files, for example by periods, and import those.
fileError.too_large_unnamed: The file is larger than the limit per file. Next step: split it into smaller files, for example by periods, and import those.
fileError.too_many_rows: The file has more rows than the limit of {{limit}} rows per file. Next step: split it into several files.
fileError.too_many_rows_unnamed: The file has more rows than the limit per file. Next step: split it into several files.
fileError.not_decodable: The text of the file cannot be read. Next step: save the file as UTF-8.
fileError.json_invalid: The file is not valid JSON. Next step: check the file or create it again.
fileError.document_invalid: The structure of the file does not match the format. Next step: create the file again with pipwerk-fetch-mt5.
fileError.header_invalid: The header row of the CSV file does not fit. Expected are date and time as well as Open, High, Low and Close (candles) or Bid and Ask (ticks). Next step: export the file from MetaTrader 5 again.
fileError.series_invalid: Broker, instrument or data of the file are invalid. Next step: check the entries for the file and import it again.
fileError.timezone_unknown: The time zone is unknown. Next step: enter an IANA name, for example Europe/Athens, and import the file again.
fileError.period_invalid: The period of the file is invalid. Next step: check the times in the file.
fileError.no_rows: The file contains no rows. Next step: check that it is the right file.
fileError.store_failed: The data stock could not take over the file. Next step: try again later.
fileError.unknown: The file was refused. Next step: check the file and import it again.

delete.chooseIntro: Choose what to delete from this series. Then you see exactly what would be deleted and confirm it. Only then is anything deleted.
delete.scopePeriod: Only a period of the series
delete.periodHint: Next step: enter the beginning and the end of the period, to the minute, with the beginning before the end and between the years 1970 and 2100.
delete.askError: It could not be checked what would be deleted. Nothing was deleted. {{reason}}
delete.seriesEnds: Afterwards the series has no data left and is removed.
delete.brokerGoes: Afterwards the broker {{broker}} has no data left and no longer occurs in the data stock.
delete.testBrokerReset: {{broker}} is chosen as the "Broker for test runs". Afterwards no broker is chosen.
delete.doneNoTestBroker: No broker for test runs is chosen now.

tip.start: The beginning of the period in UTC, to the minute. The candle or tick of this minute is deleted, too.
tip.end: The end of the period in UTC, to the minute. The candle or tick of this minute stays.

title.broker: Delete all data of this broker?

extent.contract: The contract data of {{instrument}} at this broker will be deleted.
extent.broker: {{series}} with {{candles}} and {{ticks}} will be deleted, and the contract data of {{instruments}}.

error.broker_unknown: This broker does not exist (any more). Next step: reload the view.
error.instrument_unknown: This instrument does not exist at this broker (any more). Next step: reload the view.
error.series_unknown: This series does not exist (any more). Next step: reload the view.
error.contract_unknown: There is no contract data for this instrument at this broker (any more). Next step: reload the view.
error.period_invalid: The period is invalid. Next step: enter the beginning and the end to the minute, with the beginning before the end.
error.period_empty: The series has no data in this period. Next step: choose a period in which the series has data.
